ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If Algae decreased, what would most seriously be affected?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web, labeled Algae, Rotifer, Artemia, Mysid, Young Seahorse, and Seahorse. An arrow points from Algae to Rotifer; Rotifer is then connected by arrows to Artemia, Mysid, and the seahorse-related nodes. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate the relationship of food or energy transfer. When Algae decreases, the organisms that most directly depend on Algae will be affected first and most severely. In the diagram, the one that directly receives an arrow from Algae is Rotifer, so the most severely affected are Rotifers.
